title: Drake Maye says he made 'unacceptable' decisions in Patriots' loss. He's right

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Drake Maye says he made 'unacceptable' decisions in Patriots' loss. He's right
sources.description: Patriots QB Drake Maye threw three INTs in a 13-10 loss to the Seahawks to begin the 2026 NFL season. He offered a brutal but fair assessment afterward.
